title: Wells Enterprises, Inc. — FDA Enforcement Intelligence
excerpt: Enforcement intelligence profile for Wells Enterprises, Inc. (Ferrero Group), covering 24 FDA recall actions across its ice cream and frozen dessert portfolio. A single April 2025 plastic contamination event generated 22 simultaneous recalls affecting 53,000+ gallons of product distributed to 103 centers nationwide, exposing manufacturing control gaps at America's largest privately held ice cream maker.
